# Sackar Atlas — Editorial Decisions Register

Auto-generated by `scripts/extract-editorial-decisions.py`.  
**Do not edit manually** — run the script to regenerate.

```bash
python3 scripts/extract-editorial-decisions.py sources/ > sources/EDITORIAL-DECISIONS.md
```

Run after any source file is edited. Commit the updated register alongside the source file change.

---

## About editorial decisions

When preparing source documents, editorial decisions are documented as HTML comments
inline in the source file — immediately before or after the affected content. They are
invisible to readers but grep-extractable and form the basis of this register.

Six comment types:

| Type | Comment | Use for |
|------|---------|---------|
| `ed-format` | `<!-- ed-format: ... -->` | Formatting changes (image to table, pull quote extraction, list reformatting) |
| `ed-correct` | `<!-- ed-correct: [original] → [corrected] — [reason] -->` | OCR/transcription corrections confirmed against source PDF |
| `ed-omit` | `<!-- ed-omit: [what] — [reason] -->` | Content deliberately omitted from the MD file |
| `ed-struct` | `<!-- ed-struct: ... -->` | Structural decisions (section ordering, chunk boundaries, heading placement) |
| `ed-note` | `<!-- ed-note: ... -->` | General editorial notes about the source or the MD file |
| `ed-uncertain` | `<!-- ed-uncertain: ... -->` | Uncertain readings or ambiguous source text; flag for review |

### Examples

```markdown
<!-- ed-format: Converted embedded image to markdown table. Original: 3-column table of case outcomes on PDF p.87 -->
<!-- ed-correct: "tbe" → "the" — OCR error confirmed against PDF p.247 -->
<!-- ed-omit: NSW Parliament Library cataloguing block omitted — formatting artefact, not substantive content -->
<!-- ed-struct: Split chapter at this point. Content continues from PDF p.112. See part_of in header for parent file. -->
<!-- ed-note: Section heading appears mid-paragraph in PDF; rendered as ## heading here for navigability -->
<!-- ed-uncertain: Word illegible in PDF scan — best read as "Neiwand" but confirm against PDF p.183 -->
```

See `docs/workflow-source-documents.md` for full guidance.
